description: This file contains the model class 'ModelPermGroup' for representing permission groups in the Apache OFBiz framework. It manages a list of permissions, join types, and provides methods to evaluate permissions within the service context.

classes.name: ModelPermGroup
classes.description: Represents a group of permissions with logic to evaluate them based on join type (AND/OR). Implements Serializable, manages a list of permissions, and provides evaluation methods.

methods.name: setJoinType
methods.description: Sets the join type ('AND' or 'OR') used to combine permission evaluations.

methods.name: getPermissions
methods.description: Returns the list of permissions associated with this permission group.

methods.name: evalPermissions
methods.description: Evaluates permissions within the provided context and dispatch environment, returning success or error map based on evaluation logic.
